title: Passive Voice: Who and Which Questions — Quiz 110
content:
## Passive Voice: Who and Which Questions

Change questions with who and which into the passive voice.

### Lesson focus

1. Who stole my chocolate?
2. By whom was my chocolate stolen?
3. Who broke the window?
4. Who can solve this puzzle?
5. Which team won the match?

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
